corrections.form_value: Systematic review and taxonomy of creativity measurement methods in human-AI co-creativity research. It contains no primary experiment, and the abstract reports no pooled effect size; it synthesizes evaluation practices, not effects. Judged from the abstract only (full text closed access).
corrections.source_says: The abstract describes a systematic review and taxonomy, and reports no primary experiment or pooled effect. Replace the categorical statement "It contains no primary experiment" with "No primary experiment is reported in the accessible abstract; whether the full article includes additional primary research could not be checked." The synthesis classification is supported, but full-text absence of a randomized people study is unverified.
corrections.quote: To address this pressing need, we conduct a systematic review of Human-AI (HAI) co-creativity measurement metrics and evaluative methods.

corrections.form_value: Review of how creativity is defined and measured in human-AI co-creative tasks; no task performed by participants.
corrections.source_says: The abstract describes analysis of existing creativity measurement practices. Replace "no task performed by participants" with "No primary participant task is described in the accessible abstract; full text was unavailable."
corrections.quote: Through a critical analysis of how creativity is conceptualized and measured, we synthesize existing evaluation practices into a taxonomy for interpreting HAI co-creativity research.

corrections.source_says: Company involvement cannot be confirmed or excluded from the abstract and bibliographic records. Crossref lists university and CNRS affiliations, has no funder field, and provides no funding or conflict-of-interest disclosure in its assertions; these facts do not establish absence of company involvement. Record null and explain that involvement is not ascertainable from the sources read.

summary: The accessible abstract and bibliographic metadata support the synthesis classification, and no randomized people study was identified. Three corrections qualify claims about the absence of primary participant research and company involvement that these sources cannot establish.
